snippet.title: Into The Unwell - Day Of The Devs Trailer #dayofthedevs #dayofthedevs2026 #intotheunwell
snippet.description:
Join the official Into The Unwell Discord: http://discord.gg/intotheunwell
Wishlist on Steam: http://s.team/a/2024600/

Whack-and-slash your inner demons in this third-person roguelite, set in a rubber hose fuelled fever dream! Play 1-3 players as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits.

Find us on
Website: https://shewassuchagoodhorse.com/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/suchagoodhorse
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@intotheunwell_official
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/shewassuchagoodhorse.com

Into The Unwell is developed by She Was Such A Good Horse, published by Coffee Stain Publishing.
